parts.name: Hand Crank Lift System - Linear Leg Unit
parts.description: Hydraulic linear leg unit from the Hand Crank Lift System, which raises a frame with a hand-cranked hydraulic pump. The system works with 15, 30, 40 and 45 series profiles.
features: Included in kit: hydraulic pump with hand crank (1), linear leg units (4), rubber leveling feet (4), mounting brackets (8), M5 x 8mm bolts (16)
Kit ships in one box weighing 29 lbs and measuring 35” x 12” x 9” in size
Works with 15, 30, 40, 45 series profiles
Made up of primarily aluminum, plastic and stainless steel
Max load: 450 kg (992 lbs) – includes weight of frame
Max stroke: 300mm (11.811”)
Lifting speed: 5mm (.197”) per hand crank turn
Retracted height of legs: 445mm (17.520”)
Extended height of legs: 745mm (29.331”)
parts.dimension_notes: A x B = leg cross-section, C = retracted length, L = extended length; the leg end has a ø M10 x 1.5, 25mm deep thread and the side has ø M5 x 0.8, 5.5mm deep threaded holes; hydraulic tubing runs to the crank pump

suggested_hardware.context: Mount to T-Slot (15/40 series row, used with 11-6042 washer and 3838 T-nut)

parts.notes: Only part number printed for the Hand Crank Lift System (pages 7-92 and 7-93); it is in the Linear Leg Unit table, so it is unclear whether 2371 is the complete kit or the leg unit alone. Row badged 15, 30, 40 and 45. Included hardware: M5 x 8mm FHSCS (16). Pump note: use T-nut 3278 or 3838 in T-slot for mounting. Kit components on 7-93 have no part numbers: Hydraulic Pump with Hand Crank (Aluminum & Plastic, Gray; A 6.509" (165.33mm), B 2.559” (64.99mm), C 2.355” (59.82mm), D 5.335” (722.94mm), E 7.411” (188.24mm), F 1.093” (27.76mm), G 18.996” (465.40mm), H 118.142” (3000.81mm), J 1.181” (29.99mm), K .315” (8.00mm), L .904” (22.96mm), M .157” (3.99mm), N .256” (6.50mm), P 1.178” (29.91mm)); Mounting Bracket (Steel, Gray; A 1.929" (48.99mm), B 1.260” (32.00mm), C .157” (3.99mm), D .228” (5.80mm), E .335” (8.50mm), F .984” (24.99mm), G .394” (10.00mm), H .945” (24.00mm), J .630” (16.00mm), K .413” (10.50mm)); Rubber Leveling Feet (A .630" (16.00mm), B 1.850” (46.99mm), C 1.725” (43.82mm), D .819” (20.80mm), E .315” (8.00mm), F .591” (15.01mm), G thread M10 x 1.5). The pump's D and G inch/mm values do not agree as printed (5.335” vs 722.94mm, 18.996” vs 465.40mm).
